# DEXOP

DEXOP: A Device for Robotic Transfer of Dexterous Human Manipulation

**2025-09-04 · Preprint · Not reported**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.04441)** · [Project](https://dex-op.github.io)

A passive robot-hand exoskeleton captures transferable visual/tactile demonstrations for bimanual dexterous imitation.

**Scope and qualifications**

- Mixed teleop subset compensates arm-exoskeleton assembly errors; claimed transfer does not use solely passive device data.
